evals.prompt: 我想打开 KCoder 的自进化，但只让它学习技能，学到的改动要等我确认后才生效。怎么配置？
evals.expected_output: Turn on evolution.enabled in the user scope, keep mode propose, and switch off the preference and project_knowledge targets.
expectations: Writes the setting to the user scope, not project settings
Sets evolution.enabled to true and keeps evolution.mode as propose (the default)
Disables the other target types, for example evolution.targets.preference.enabled and evolution.targets.project_knowledge.enabled set to false
Mentions that self-evolution makes extra calls to the selected model

evals.prompt: Why does "evolution": {"mode": "auto"} in my project's .kcoder/settings.json have no effect?
evals.expected_output: Project and local settings may only set evolution.enabled to false; other evolution keys there are ignored with a warning, so set it in user settings.
expectations: Explains that project/local settings can only turn evolution off (enabled false)
Explains that the other evolution keys there are ignored with a load warning
Recommends setting evolution.mode in the user settings instead

evals.prompt: Add my DeepSeek API key so I can use the deepseek provider.
evals.expected_output: Store the key through kcoder auth login for the deepseek provider, never in settings.json or project files.
expectations: Uses kcoder auth login --provider deepseek to store the credential
Does not put the API key in settings.json, project configuration or an imported file
Checks the result with kcoder auth status

evals.prompt: 项目里 .kcoder/settings.json 配的 MCP 服务器一直没加载，怎么排查？
evals.expected_output: Check project trust with kcoder trust status, trust only after explicit user confirmation, and verify in a new session.
expectations: Runs kcoder trust status --path for the project first
Adds trust only after the user explicitly confirms the directory is trusted
Verifies the MCP server in a new session

evals.prompt: 帮我把 training_mode: true 写进 settings.json，我要录训练轨迹。
evals.expected_output: Refuse to write it: training mode is a CLI/runtime switch (--training-mode); pair it with a memory-free overlay and a fresh session.
expectations: Explains that training_mode is not a settings field and writing it fails validation
Recommends a memory-free --settings-file overlay and a brand-new session

evals.prompt: I want to use the ocr tool to read text from a scanned PDF. How do I enable it?
evals.expected_output: Explain that ocr is the OpenCodeReview code-review tool, not optical character recognition, and use read for scanned pages.
expectations: Explains that ocr is OpenCodeReview code review, not optical character recognition
Recommends the read tool, which renders pages without a text layer as images for a vision-capable model
Does not remove ocr from tools.disabled for this purpose
